name: Juma
tagline: AI workspace built especially for marketers. By marketers.
description: Your brand voice, tone guides and ICPs already loaded. AI that knows how to do proper SEO. From competitor analysis to campaign launch — every step connected, with your team in the loop.
story: Born as Team-GPT in April 2023. OpenAI's lawyers sent two letters about the name — so in November 2025 we launched Juma at True Ventures' HQ in San Francisco.
